Prepare Test Omics Data as SummarizedExperiment

Source: R/variable_screening.R
prepare_test_SE.Rd

Aligns a test omics matrix to the feature set of the corresponding training SummarizedExperiment, retaining only the features selected during training and ordering rows consistently. The result is packaged as a SummarizedExperiment inheriting the preprocessing metadata of the training object.

Usage

prepare_test_SE(test_data, train_se, on_constant = c("drop", "error", "keep"))

Arguments

test_data

Numeric matrix of omics data for the test set (features as rows, samples as columns). Row names must be set.

train_se

A SummarizedExperiment object produced by one of the prepare_* functions (mRNA, miRNA, CNV, Methylation). The features retained in assays(train_se)$counts define the target feature set.

on_constant

Character. What to do with test samples that are constant across the (remaining) training features: "drop" (default) removes them, "error" stops, "keep" retains them.

Value

A SummarizedExperiment object with:

  • assays$counts: Test matrix restricted to training features, in the same row order as train_se, with constant samples handled per on_constant.

  • metadata$preprocessing: Inherited from train_se, with split = "test" and n_features updated.

See also

prepare_RNA, prepare_methyl, prepare_CNV
